notes.notes:

Patch Notes: 

Game engine version update.
Improved multiplayer stability.
Improved optimization.
Completely new weather system.
Interface has been updated.
Fixed a bug where the cutscene played the wrong voice.
Rewritten artificial intelligence opponents.
Added support for ultrawide monitors.
